cards.title: 15 heroes in the game
cards.text: Each hero's attack, three abilities with three tiers, and trait. Tick the ones you like; comment on any.
cards.why: These are in the game now (being finished). Your notes here change what each one does.
cards.details: Base attacks are plain. Abilities and their tiers are bought in each hero's skill tree with gold; a bought tier switches on in a run once the hero reaches its level there (2, 5 and 8). Tier III also needs the hero to have reached level 8 in a dungeon once.

items.label: Paladin
items.text:
Sword and shield. Stands in front and keeps the others alive. (tank; Starter.)

Attack: Sword.

Shield Bash (free from the start): Lunges into an enemy with the shield, knocking it back.
I: Knocks back and staggers. II: Stuns for a moment as well. III: Hits everything in front, not just one.

Guard: Stands beside a hurt ally and takes part of the damage meant for them.
I: Takes 40% of their damage for 5s. II: Takes 60%. III: Also heals them 15% when it starts.

Consecrate: Holy ground around him: hurts enemies, mends allies.
I: A ring of light for 4s. II: Bigger and lasts 6s. III: Undead in it burn.

Trait, Bulwark: Blocks 35% of damage that comes from the front.

items.label: Tower
items.text:
A wall with a mace. Pulls every enemy onto himself. (tank; Unlocked with 2 gems.)

Attack: Flanged mace.

Hold the Line (free from the start): Plants the tower shield and calls enemies to him.
I: Takes 60% less damage from the front and taunts those near for 4s. II: Taunts further, for 6s. III: Hits taken while planted are struck back.

Charge: Charges in a line, bowling enemies aside.
I: A short charge. II: Longer, and slams enemies into walls harder. III: Staggers everything it hits.

Ground Pound: Slams the shield down: a ring that shoves enemies away.
I: Knocks back. II: Staggers as well. III: A second ring follows.

Trait, Unmovable: Can't be knocked back.

items.label: Archer
items.text:
Shoots from behind the front line. (ranged; Starter.)

Attack: Bow.

Barrage (free from the start): A fan of arrows.
I: Five arrows. II: Seven arrows, set alight. III: The arrows go through.

Frost Arrow: A frost-tipped arrow.
I: Chills hard. II: Freezes. III: Bursts, chilling all around.

Roll: Rolls out of reach when something gets close.
I: A quick roll back. II: The next arrow after a roll hits twice as hard. III: Leaves caltrops that slow.

Trait, Steady Aim: After standing still for 1.5s, the next arrow is a critical hit.

items.label: Twinfang
items.text:
Hooked daggers. Picks off the ones on their own. (skirmish; Starter.)

Attack: Twin daggers.

Backstab (free from the start): Steps into the shadows and appears behind the target.
I: A big hit from behind. II: Poisons too. III: A kill resets it.

Dash: A burst of speed: in at a lone target, or out of reach.
I: One dash. II: Leaves smoke: enemies lose sight of her. III: Two dashes before it recharges.

Fan of Knives: Throws knives all around.
I: Eight knives. II: They poison. III: Twelve knives, and they go through.

Trait, Opportunist: +50% damage to enemies fighting someone else.

items.label: Wildmane
items.text:
Big sword, bigger temper. (melee; Unlocked with 2 gems.)

Attack: Greatsword.

Rage (free from the start): Takes less damage and attacks and moves faster for a while.
I: For 5s. II: Her hits also heal her. III: For 8s, and nothing knocks her back.

Leap: Leaps onto a far enemy; the landing shoves those around.
I: A leap. II: Lands harder, staggering. III: Leaps again straight after.

Cleave: A full spin with the sword.
I: Hits everything around. II: Wider, and knocks back. III: Spins twice.

Trait, Bloodied: Hits harder the more hurt she is: up to +50%.

items.label: Berserker
items.text:
A flail and no plan. Shockwaves. (melee; Unlocked with 2 gems.)

Attack: Flail.

Shockwave (free from the start): Slams the ground, sending a shockwave forward that repeats.
I: Three waves. II: Five waves. III: The waves stagger.

Whirl: Spins the flail while moving, hitting everything around.
I: For 3s. II: For 5s. III: Pulls enemies in.

Unstoppable: Shakes off every status and can't be stopped for a moment.
I: Clears statuses, 2s of immunity. II: 4s. III: Heals 20% too.

Trait, Momentum: Each hit in a row makes the next a little faster, up to +50%.

items.label: Granny Reaper
items.text:
Scythe. Sweeps all the way round. (melee; Unlocked with 3 gems.)

Attack: Scythe.

Reap (free from the start): A full sweep all the way round her.
I: Hits everyone close. II: Reaches further. III: Heals her for each enemy hit.

Hook: Hooks a far enemy and drags it to her.
I: One enemy. II: Staggers it on arrival. III: Two enemies.

Old Bones: When she would go down, she shrugs it off.
I: Stays up at 1 HP once per room. II: Heals 20% when it saves her. III: Knocks everything around back too.

Trait, Grim: Finishes off any enemy her hits leave below 12% health.

items.label: Pyromancer
items.text:
Fire, mostly. (caster; Unlocked with 2 gems.)

Attack: Spark.

Fireball (free from the start): A slow fireball that bursts.
I: Bursts and burns. II: Leaves burning ground. III: Bigger burst.

Flame Wall: A line of fire across the enemies' way.
I: Burns what walks through. II: Longer and lasts longer. III: Sets oil off from further away.

Inferno: A ring of fire bursts out of her.
I: Burns all near. II: Knocks them back. III: Leaves her immune to burning for 6s.

Trait, Kindling: Burning enemies take 20% more from her.

items.label: Frost Mage
items.text:
Slows everything down, then shatters it. (caster; Unlocked with 2 gems.)

Attack: Snow bolt.

Ice Shard (free from the start): A shard that goes through enemies in a line.
I: Chills. II: Chills harder. III: Splits into three.

Frost Nova: Freezes everything close to her.
I: Freezes for a moment. II: Bigger. III: Frozen enemies take double damage.

Ice Wall: Raises a wall of ice that blocks enemies.
I: A short wall for 5s. II: Longer, 8s. III: It chills what touches it.

Trait, Cold Blood: Can't be chilled or frozen.

items.label: Storm Mage
items.text:
Lightning that jumps. Loves wet enemies. (caster; Unlocked with 3 gems.)

Attack: Zap.

Chain Lightning (free from the start): A bolt that jumps from enemy to enemy, shocking.
I: Jumps 3 times. II: Jumps 5 times. III: Jumps back to enemies already hit.

Thunderclap: A crack of thunder around a target.
I: Staggers. II: Bigger. III: Shocks too.

Storm Cloud: A cloud over the enemies that rains and strikes.
I: Soaks what's under it. II: Strikes lightning too. III: Follows the enemies.

Trait, Conductor: Shock lasts twice as long on wet enemies.

items.label: Cleric
items.text:
Heals, and brings the fallen back fast. (support; Unlocked with 1 gems.)

Attack: Sceptre.

Mend (free from the start): Heals the most hurt ally nearby.
I: Heals 20%. II: Heals 30%. III: Heals a second ally too.

Sanctuary: A circle of light that heals allies standing in it.
I: For 5s. II: Bigger, 7s. III: Enemies can't step in.

Smite: A pillar of light on an enemy.
I: Hurts and staggers. II: Hurts more. III: Undead take triple.

Trait, Raiser: Revives the downed three times faster, at 40% health.

items.label: Bard
items.text:
Songs that make the others better. (support; Unlocked with 2 gems.)

Attack: Sour note.

War Song (free from the start): Allies near attack faster for a while.
I: +25% for 6s. II: +40%. III: They move faster too.

Lullaby: Enemies in front grow slow and drowsy.
I: Slows for 4s. II: Puts the weakest to sleep. III: Wider.

Encore: An ally's ability is ready again.
I: One ally. II: Heals them 10% too. III: Two allies.

Trait, Rhythm: Allies near the bard move 10% faster.

items.label: Druid
items.text:
Vines, healing, and a wolf. (support; Unlocked with 2 gems.)

Attack: Thorn.

Entangle (free from the start): Vines burst up and hold enemies in place.
I: Holds for 1.5s. II: Bigger patch. III: The vines poison.

Rejuvenate: Heals an ally slowly over time.
I: 30% over 6s. II: 45%. III: Two allies.

Call Wolf: A wolf comes to fight beside the party for a while.
I: For 15s. II: A bigger wolf. III: Two wolves.

Trait, Barkskin: Takes 30% less damage while standing still.

items.label: Necromancer
items.text:
The dead fight for him. (caster; Unlocked with 3 gems.)

Attack: Bone dart.

Raise Dead (free from the start): Raises a fallen enemy to fight for the party for a while.
I: One skeleton, 12s. II: Two. III: They explode when they fall.

Life Drain: Drains an enemy, healing himself.
I: For 3s. II: Heals allies near him too. III: Stronger.

Bone Spear: A spear of bone through a line of enemies.
I: Goes through. II: Knocks back. III: Wider and longer.

Trait, Soul Harvest: Every enemy that dies near him shortens his cooldowns.

items.label: Plague Doctor
items.text:
Poison clouds, and cures for friends. (caster; Unlocked with 2 gems.)

Attack: Vial.

Miasma (free from the start): A flask that bursts into a poison cloud.
I: A cloud for 5s. II: Bigger. III: Enemies in it hit softer.

Cure: Clears an ally's statuses and heals a little.
I: One ally, 10%. II: 20%. III: Every ally near.

Leeches: Leeches on an enemy drain it for allies to heal from.
I: For 5s. II: Spread to one more enemy. III: Heal twice as much.

Trait, Immunity: Can't be poisoned, and his poison spreads to enemies nearby.

cards.title: My calls so far
cards.text: Choices I made while building, so a new player has a fair start. Mark any you'd change.
cards.why: You said not to wait for you, so I picked. Each part is one call; they're easy to change.

parts.title: First ability free
parts.text: Every hero starts with its first ability (tier I) already bought, so a new party of one still has a move.

parts.title: Fewer enemies for small parties
parts.text: Enemy numbers scale with party size: one hero faces about 40% of what three do.

parts.title: First runs
parts.text: A brand-new solo hero tends to fall around rooms 5 to 10 with 100 to 200 gold, enough for a node or two.

parts.title: Enemy art
parts.text: Only the enemy art you picked is used (skeletons, ghost, lizardmen, plus the rat and slime). Anything else is a placeholder until it's redrawn.
